description: This file defines Express.js routes for the dashboard overview module. It sets up middleware for authentication and tenant verification, performs a special bypass check for a specific tenant ID ('T0000'), and exposes an endpoint '/metrics' that handles dashboard metrics retrieval via an async controller.
